The 4 Pillars of Success — Expanded

Each pillar now integrates proven U.S. and international precedents.

Pillar 1

Housing Stability & Home Affordability

OHCS Flex Lending FirstHome + NextStep DPA in LMI tracts. 🎯 In OHCS Targeted Areas (8 entire counties + 41 listed tracts — incl. all 3 superfecta zones): first-time-buyer requirement waived + higher household income & purchase price limits. 💰 LIHTC: QCT tracts get a 30% basis boost on 9% credits — the multifamily construction engine for our QCT-flagged tracts. Now expanded with Fannie Mae Certified Shared Equity, employer forgivable down payment loans, and Local Coin 5% match bonus.

  • SquareOne Villages (Eugene) — $5K membership equity model
  • Fannie Mae Duty to Serve — certified shared equity list
  • 💰 LIHTC 30% QCT basis boost — 9% credits on 130% eligible basis (Klamath + Ontario housing anchor tracts)
  • Via Verde (Bronx) — 222 mixed-income units, $98.8M, LEED Gold model
  • Orchards at Orenco (Hillsboro, OR) — 57 units, largest Passive House affordable bldg in N. America, 68% energy savings
  • The Lace Mill (Kingston, NY) — 55-unit adaptive-reuse rehab via 4% LIHTC + historic credits
  • NAHB model: 100 multifamily units = 161 local jobs yr 1 (+44 recurring) + $11.7M local income
  • Track B: Employer DPA as forgivable loan (20%/yr)
Pillar 2

Youth Local Employment & Shared Equity

Track A/B/C compensation with ERISA-qualified profit-sharing. Student loan paydown (CARES Act tax-free). Innovation Prize system. Mini-ESOP structure.

  • Axia Home Loans ESOP — 100% employee-owned
  • Track C: $5,250/yr tax-free student loan paydown
  • Innovation Prize: $2,500 Local Coin bonus for top ideas
Pillar 3

Local Business Reinvigoration

CRA benefits for banks + Local Coin vendor network (zero merchant fees) + Visa partnership. BerkShares/Bristol Pound precedent. Commercial RE expansion.

  • Bristol Pound (UK) — 800 businesses, mobile app, 1% fees
  • BerkShares (MA) — 350+ businesses, 0% merchant fees
  • Visa MiniPay Card — 16M wallets, stablecoin backend
Pillar 4

Investor ROI & Company Growth

Superfecta 4-layer stack: USDA RD + OZ 2.0 QROF 30% + LMI OHCS + CRA bank credit. 💰 LIHTC equity: banks earn dollar-for-dollar federal tax reduction + CRA investment-test credit (3.7M+ affordable homes financed nationwide) — QCT 130% basis boost deepens returns on Klamath & Ontario housing tracts. Bank-sponsored QROF template. Federal grants (CHIPS/BIL/IRA).

  • Woodforest CEI-Boulos Fund — $26M OZ+CRA+LMI
  • LIHTC + CRA tandem: bank equity funds affordable construction & earns CRA credit (OCC/Fed precedent)
  • Fifth Third — $100M CRA-aligned OZ investment

The Youth Workforce Engine — Grounded in Ownership

Why talent joins, stays, and relocates to our Superfecta & Trifecta zones: every participating employer offers three compensation tracks that build residence + career stability — paid through the credit-union-branded Local Coin Visa debit card.

TRACK A

Fractional Ownership Payout

Quarterly / Annual

Shared-equity & profit-sharing payouts (mini-ESOP, ERISA-qualified) deposited straight to the Local Coin card. Workers literally own a piece of the company they build — the ultimate low-turnover incentive.

TRACK B

Homebuyer DPA — Closing Costs

→ Local Coin card

Employer-funded down payment assistance for closing costs, forgivable 20%/yr vesting. Local Coin balance counts as an OHCS Flex Lending qualified down payment source — a renter becomes an owner in a 🎯 Targeted tract.

TRACK C

Student Loan Paydown

$5,250 / yr tax-free

Employer pays the loan servicer directly on behalf of the employee — CARES Act tax-free through 2025-extended rules. Debt relief that frees up homebuying power years earlier.

Kotek may nominate up to 58 Oregon tracts from the official 229-tract eligible pool (106 rural / 123 non-rural, IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-14) during the July 1 – Sept 28, 2026 window (90 days + optional 30-day extension). Rural designations unlock the enhanced QROF 30% basis step-up (vs 10% non-rural). The Local Coin — Community Currency & Debit Card

Inspired by Bristol Pound (UK), BerkShares (MA), and MiniPay/Visa (Global). A closed-loop local economy tool that keeps capital circulating within Trifecta Zones.

💳 Visa-Branded Debit Card

White-label Visa card powered by Gnosis Pay infrastructure. Apple Pay / Google Pay compatible. 0% merchant fees for participating vendors (vs. 1.5–3.5% for credit cards). Chargeback protection included.

🏦 Credit Union Backend

Partner with Oregon Community Credit Union or OnPoint. Every Local Coin backed 1:1 by USD held in reserve. Electronic accounts managed by regulated institution — same model as Bristol Pound + Bristol Credit Union.

📱 Mobile App + Dashboard

Consumer side: balance, deposits, purchase history, "My Community Impact" score. Vendor side: monthly sales, top items, customer demographics. Both sides see real-time transaction flow.

🎁 5% Employer Match Bonus

When employer deposits Track A/B/C payouts into Local Coin, they add 5% bonus. $5,000 profit share → $5,250 in Local Coin. Bonus is tax-deductible recruitment expense. Employee sees immediate 5% upside.

🏠 Down Payment Bridge

Local Coin balance counts toward OHCS Flex Lending "qualified down payment source." App shows: "Your balance: $X. You are $Y from your FirstHome down payment goal!" Gamifies wealth-building.

🌾 Farmers Market Network

Participating vendors get "Trifecta Preferred" badge. Cardholders get $25 bonus after spending $500 locally. Vendors can see branded card at checkout, reinforcing community identity. Backend tracks all vendor sales monthly.

🌾 Farmers Market Network — Lane County Farmers Market, Eugene HYPOTHETICAL MODEL

🏆 No. 1 in Oregon — 2025 America's Farmers Market Celebration 🧑‍🌾 100+ farm & food artisan vendors, all Oregon-grown/made 📅 Saturdays mid-Jan → mid-Dec @ 8th & Oak 📅 + Tuesday & Springfield Sunday markets 💳 SNAP/EBT · WIC · Senior Farm Direct · market tokens
1 · Vendors enrollEvery vendor in the market signs up as an official Local Coin participant vendor — one network agreement covers the whole market via the LCFM member list.
2 · Members shopCredit union members pay any market vendor with the CU-branded Local Coin Visa debit card — zero merchant fees for vendors, rewards for shoppers.
3 · Quarterly give-backThe credit union deposits 0.5% of gross Local Coin Visa vendor transactions (combined vendor quarterly sales) into the Farmers Market Network "Local Coin" savings account at the same CU.

📊 The quarterly deposit, estimated (OFMA vendor/crowd-count method)

≈ $2.0M combined vendor sales / quarter× 25% on Local Coin Visa= $500K card volume× 0.5%= $2,500 / quarter→ ≈ $10,000 / year network fund
Estimation basis: Oregon Farmers Markets Association method — vendor counts × average per-vendor sales, cross-checked with crowd counts × average spend (OSU Extension Rapid Market Assessment). Illustrative figures: 100+ vendors × ~13 Saturday + ~13 Tuesday market days per quarter; 25% card-share assumption. The network fund can bankroll vendor stall-fee relief, new-vendor microgrants, and market marketing — while deposits, float, and loyalty stay at the credit union.
Real LCFM member vendors the network would include: Hideaway Bakery, SLO Farm (Seasonal · Local · Organic) & 100+ more — full member list at lanecountyfarmersmarket.org/vendors

Proven Precedents — U.S. & International

Real programs already operating that validate every component of the Trifecta/Superfecta framework.

Woodforest CEI-Boulos Opportunity Fund

USA — 17 states

$26M fund targeting OZ + LMI + CRA convergence. High-impact real estate in bank retail footprint. Job creation, affordable housing, Main Street revitalization. Bank-sponsored QOF template.

Fifth Third Bank OZ + CRA Alignment

USA — Midwest/Southeast

$100M committed to OZ investments with explicit CRA criteria. Three categories: affordable housing, workforce housing, non-residential community real estate. Projects must be in bank's CRA-identified need areas.

SquareOne Villages / Peace Village Co-op

Eugene, Oregon

$5,000 membership equity in limited-equity cooperative. 3%/year resale cap preserves affordability. Revolving loan fund finances 80% of membership. Monthly costs $450–$750 including all expenses — no ongoing subsidy.

Bristol Pound + Bristol Credit Union

Bristol, United Kingdom

UK's first citywide local currency with electronic accounts at regulated credit union. 800+ businesses. TXT2PAY at 1% fee. City council accepts for taxes. Mayor paid in local currency. Mobile app with map + payments.

BerkShares Local Currency

Berkshires, Massachusetts

140,000 B$ in circulation. 350+ businesses. 9 bank branches exchange 1:1. 0% merchant fees. 1.5% cash-out fee incentivizes local circulation. Digital beta tested 2022 with 80 businesses. Paper + electronic.

MiniPay Card (Visa + Gnosis Pay)

Global — 65+ countries

16M activated wallets. Stablecoin-backed Visa debit card. Merchants receive local currency, no crypto knowledge needed. Apple Pay / Google Pay. Cashback in USDC/USDT. Proves stablecoin-to-fiat card is production-ready.
